expected_after_fix: The icon should show the correct initials of the user who created the parts request, and the full name on hover.

Attempted to open the work order parts view - the standalone /workorders/{id}/parts route returns 'The page does not exist!' (404)

actual_now: The standalone per-work-order Parts tab described in the ticket no longer exists (the /parts route 404s); parts are surfaced inside the lines view as a 'Parts (N)' sub-tab. notes: Ticket status is OBSOLETE in Jira; the feature/UI referenced has been reworked. Not re-tested against original repro because the described surface no longer exists.
